name: Soul Tap generates 50 Runic Power
contract: Soul Tap 807397 promises 50 Runic Power on cast. Its single effect is native SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE (30) with MiscValue 6 (POWER_RUNIC_POWER), EffectBasePoints 499 and DieSides 1 (range 499-500). Spell::EffectEnergize (SpellEffects.cpp) adds this value directly to the unit's power with no CoA registration required; AscensionCompat.cpp:2734 divides the internally stored value by 10 for the client display, so 499-500 internal matches the tooltip's 50. #3712 reported no CoA source references 807397 - true, and expected: the effect is entirely core-handled, so no script or contract row is needed. PR #3946 already sampled this at runtime and could not reproduce the reported failure (Runic Power was granted).

steps.label: Soul Tap generated 499-500 internal Runic Power (50 displayed)
